name: Password Recovery Rejected
summary: An anonymous user submits recovery proof that cannot be accepted, recovery does not advance to password replacement, and the public result remains neutral about the underlying rejection reason.
finalOutcome: No password is changed, no reset token is exposed to the user, and the user remains in recovery with a neutral invalid-or-expired-code result.

sourceReferences.note: VerifyPasswordResetCodeAsync intentionally returns the same public failure for malformed, unknown-user, expired, consumed, attempt-exhausted, and mismatched recovery codes.
Password Recovery rejection reasons are permutations beneath one canonical behavior because they share the same user-visible outcome and permitted next actions.
